name: Footer
description: Site footer: brand and tagline, link columns or one row of links, social links and the copyright line.

layout.description: simple: brand left, links and copyright right. columns: brand column plus one column per link group.

tone.description: Surface with a top border, muted surface, or dark (ink) background.

align.description: start: brand and links to the sides (left-aligned on phones). center: everything centred in one column, as themes with a centred footer print it.

pack.description: columns layout only. spread: the link columns share the footer's width after the brand column. end: they are packed at the end edge at their own width, as a theme whose footer is the brand left and its menus on the right.

narrow.description: Packed columns only, below the md breakpoint. stack: one column. row: still side by side from the start edge, under the brand.

title.description: Heading shown above the links; leave out when the source shows none.

label.description: Accessible name of the column navigation (the menu name); defaults to the title.

columns.description: Link groups for the columns layout; each footer menu or widget area becomes one.

links.description: One row of links (the footer menu) for the simple layout.

address.description: Postal address; line breaks are kept.

phone.description: Phone number, linked as tel: when it has digits.

contact.description: Contact details printed in an address block under the tagline; the block is left out when none is set.

copyright.description: Copyright line; {year} is the current year. Defaults to © <year> <siteName>; the component also takes false for no line (the cookie settings control stays).

consentLabel.description: Label of the cookie settings button after the copyright line; it reopens the consent bar (withdrawal, GDPR 7(3)). Set only when the site has a consent bar.

navLabel.description: Accessible name of the footer navigation (ui-strings nav.footer).

packGap.description: Packed columns only: the space between columns, a CSS length such as 98px.

packGapNarrow.description: Packed columns in a row only: the space between them below the md breakpoint, a CSS length.

linkSize.description: Font size of the footer's links, a CSS length such as 17.88px; absent, the footer's own.

linkSizeNarrow.description: Font size of the footer's links below the md breakpoint, a CSS length such as 16.4px; absent, linkSize holds at every width.

border.description: A border on the footer's top side; absent, the default tone has one and the others do not.

a11y: One <footer> landmark; each link group is a <nav> named by its title. Social links open in a new tab with rel=me.
